brief:
A British court cleared Sarah Cotte of charges related to voicing support for Hamas during a university speech, Al Jazeera English reported. Cotte maintained her comments were not endorsements of the militant group but rather expressions of support for Palestinians' right to resist.

The case centered on remarks made in an academic setting, where Cotte's statements drew scrutiny under UK laws governing support for designated terrorist organizations. The acquittal resolves the legal challenge against her.
dek: Sarah Cotte said her comments were not in support of Hamas, but in support of Palestinians' right to resist.
title: UK court acquits woman accused of supporting Hamas in university speech
